captions.detailed: A countertop blender featuring a solid matte black rectangular base with rounded corners. Mounted on top is a tall, semi-transparent frosted polycarbonate jar with a dark grey bottom collar and a black curved handle on the side. The jar is capped with a thick black rectangular lid that includes a small hinged dark grey fill cap on top. Inside the bottom of the jar, a four-blade steel assembly is mounted on a central drive coupling.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a commercial countertop blender. It should feature a matte black rectangular motor base, a tall frosted polycarbonate jar with a side handle, a four-blade assembly at the bottom on a revolute joint, and a black lid with a hinged fill cap on a revolute hinge.
captions.factory: Construct the motor base by modeling a rounded rectangular box. Create the blender jar using a hollowed-out rectangular extrusion with rounded vertical edges, adding a curved swept cylinder for the handle. Model the blade assembly using thin rotated rectangular boxes on a central cylinder, and mount it via a revolute joint. Build the main lid as a flat rectangular box with a central opening, and attach a hinged fill cap using a revolute joint on one edge.
